invariants: The Markdown adapter owns status-row rendering; the lifecycle controller remains independent of project Markdown syntax.
An accept transition removes the proposal-only contract link and maps every staging/P0-PB-ID path to its active path in the same checklist write.
A staging link owned by another PairBlock rejects the transition and preserves the checklist bytes.
Applied and Complete rows contain neither staging paths nor proposal-only Source and tests links.
exclusions: Contract proposal records retain staging links because they preserve the reviewed proposal; only authoritative checklist status rows switch to active code.
